text:
Nina R: hey ppl-ops, quick q — we had a high-perf IC who missed the promo cycle. can we submit an out-of-cycle promotion this month? :wave:

Omar (People Ops): short answer: yes, but there are extra steps. please use the promotions form and flag it as "out-of-cycle". link: <https://redwood.company/promotions-form>

Sophie T: tagging because i'm the manager — what's the approval path? do we need L4+ director ok or exec signoff?

Jen C (Comp): approval path: manager -> squad lead -> comp owner -> people ops -> finance for comp budget signoff. if requested increase >12% or title change across bands, we require VP signoff.

Alejandro M: if we submit now, when would comp take effect? next payroll or retro?

Omar (People Ops): payroll deadlines matter. submit by EOD Friday for next-month effective date (HR needs 7 business days to process). retro pay limited to changes approved within the last 60 days; exceptions require People Ops + Finance exec approval.

Nina R: ok — what docs do you need on the form? manager justification + calibration notes?

Jen C (Comp): send 1) manager justification (2–3 bullets on impact + metrics), 2) updated role doc or releveled job checklist, 3) peer calibration evidence (short notes), 4) current comp and proposed comp. keep it concise.

Sophie T: do we need to loop in hiring manager if they're on another team? like for cross-functional leveling?

Omar (People Ops): yes — include manager of record and any dotted-line leads. if the promotion affects org chart or budget owner, CC them in the form.

Finance Bot: FYI: budget owners must confirm available headroom. automated confirmation usually takes 24–48h after submission. :moneybag:

Alejandro M: curious — does title change trigger system updates (GSuite, badge, repo teams)? who owns that?

HR Bot: People Ops creates the HR record once comp + title approved. IT & Security get a ticket automatically for badge/groups updates. timeline ~2–3 business days after final approval.

Sophie T: any guidance on communication to the IC? manager or People Ops does the announcement?

Omar (People Ops): manager owns the conversation and announcement. People Ops can provide a template (one-liner + comp note) if you want. avoid public channels until the employee is informed. :white_check_mark:

Jen C (Comp): also: if you plan to backfill or bump others in same band, note potential calibration impact. we may hold promos for a 48h calibration window.

Nina R: great — i'll fill the form and attach the bullet doc. tagging @Sophie T to confirm wording. thanks everyone! :pray:

Sophie T: got it, will review before submission.

Omar (People Ops): ping me if you want a quick pre-check (5–10m). happy to triage and advise on approvals so it moves fast. :rocket:
